8.6.1 EthIf_MainFunctionRx
[SWS_EthIf_00097] Definition of scheduled function EthIf_MainFunctionRx ⌈
Service Name
EthIf_MainFunctionRx
Syntax
void EthIf_MainFunctionRx (
void
)
Service ID [hex]
0x20
Description
The function checks for new received frames and issues reception indications in polling mode.
Available via
SchM_EthIf.h
⌋
[SWS_EthIf_00099] ⌈The receive frame check shall be pre compile time configurable
On/Off by the configuration parameter: EthIfEnableRxInterrupt.⌋
